outputs.explanation: Panel a is an illustrative schematic/example demonstrating image cropping, rotation and resizing conventions, not a data panel derived from replicated experimental observations, so replicate reporting does not apply.
Panel b shows example images illustrating spacing/separation conventions in figures, not quantitative or replicated experimental data requiring n reporting.
Panel c is a demonstrative example of showing inset/zoom origin, not a data panel presenting replicated measurements.
Panel d illustrates brightness/contrast adjustment on a single example image; it is a formatting demonstration, not a replicated experimental result.
Panel e demonstrates channel annotation practices using example images; no quantitative replicated data is presented.
Panel f shows an example image split into grayscale channels to illustrate a formatting recommendation, not replicated experimental data.
Panel g illustrates use of calibration/intensity scales on example images; it is a formatting demonstration and does not present replicated quantitative data requiring n reporting.
